swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A steel spoon is attracted to a magnet. Reason (R): steel is a combination of metals that includes iron, and such combinations are also attracted towards magnets.

add.q: Assertion (A): A steel spoon is attracted to a magnet. Reason (R): This is because, when two magnets are brought close together, their like poles repel each other while their unlike poles attract each other. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A magnet can move a steel paperclip lying on the other side of a glass sheet. Reason (R): glass is a non-magnetic material, and Activity 4.7 shows the magnetic effect can act through non-magnetic materials.

add.q: Assertion (A): A magnet can move a steel paperclip lying on the other side of a glass sheet. Reason (R): This is because glass is a magnetic material, and magnetism only acts through other magnetic materials placed in its way. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
